verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an inference engine with a hosted Wally Cloud serving option, so prefill/decode disaggregation for large-scale serving is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack describes splitting prefill and decode phases or any related serving architecture. Cloud models running on RunAnywhere's hardware and the NPU and kernel optimizations are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
